entities.name: Sukurvia
entities.description: Desert in southern Jamuraa on Dominaria, east of Palmyra and west of the Scarwood.

entities.name: Sunken Sea
entities.description: Underground sea beneath Sukurvia that surfaces to form oases.

entities.name: Efravans
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe living in Sukurvia's oases.

entities.name: Hooraree
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe living in Sukurvia's oases.

entities.name: Khyyiani
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe living in Sukurvia's oases.

entities.name: Sulaki
entities.description: Cat warrior tribe living in Sukurvia's oases.

entities.name: River Toloron
entities.description: River bordering Sukurvia in the west, dividing it from the Western Wastes.

entities.name: Johan's Joy
entities.description: Dammed lake at the edge of Palmyra once connected to the Sunken Sea; drained when the dam was destroyed.

entities.name: Osai Desert
entities.description: Desert of Shandalar whose vultures came to Sukurvia.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Event that likely closed the portal through which vultures reached Sukurvia.

events.summary: Sukurvia becomes host to vultures from the Osai Desert of Shandalar.
events.quote: Sukurvia became host to vultures from the Osai Desert of Shandalar

relations.note: Live in oases of the desert.
relations.quote: Four tribes of cat warriors , the Efravans , Hooraree , Khyyiani , and Sulaki , live in these oases.
